#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Attempts to fetch instance metadata from common cloud providers.
# Note: Most metadata endpoints are only reachable from within the cloud VM.

fetch() {
  local name="$1" url="$2"
  echo "== ${name} =="
  if curl -fsS --max-time 2 "$url"; then
    echo
  else
    echo "(unavailable)"
  fi
  echo
}

# AWS EC2 IMDSv1 (IMDSv2 requires a token; kept simple here)
fetch "AWS EC2 metadata" "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id"

# GCP metadata server requires the Metadata-Flavor header
echo "== GCP metadata =="
if curl -fsS --max-time 2 -H "Metadata-Flavor: Google" \
  "http://169.254.169.254/computeMetadata/v1/instance/id"; then
  echo
else
  echo "(unavailable)"
fi
echo

# Azure metadata service requires the Metadata header and api-version
echo "== Azure metadata =="
if curl -fsS --max-time 2 -H "Metadata: true" \
  "http://169.254.169.254/metadata/instance?api-version=2021-02-01"; then
  echo
else
  echo "(unavailable)"
fi
